terms.heroSubtitle: Website, enquiry, quotation, delivery, warranty, and support terms for One&Only.
terms.overviewTitle: The operating terms behind quotations, orders, delivery, and support.
terms.overviewDescription: These terms explain how website information, commercial quotations, project execution, and warranty-backed support are handled in practice.

sections.heading: General Terms and Conditions
sections.body: These Terms and Conditions govern the use of this website and all commercial dealings with One&Only, including product enquiries, quotations, supply, and support services.

sections.heading: 1. Scope
sections.body: These terms apply to all business relationships with customers, subject to any project-specific written agreement executed between both parties.

sections.heading: 2. Quotations and acceptance
sections.body: Product and service information on this website is informational. A binding transaction occurs only after written quote acceptance and order confirmation.

sections.heading: 3. Delivery and installation
sections.body: Delivery schedules are shared at order confirmation and may vary by project scope, site readiness, and material availability.

sections.heading: 4. Warranty and support
sections.body: Warranty applicability follows the specific product line and agreed terms. Service and support requests are handled through our official channels.

sections.heading: 5. Liability
sections.body: Liability is limited to the extent permitted by law and the value or terms agreed in the corresponding commercial contract.

terms.asideGuidance: Use this page together with the refund, privacy, and service routes when a client needs clear guidance on commercial handling, support scope, or warranty-backed follow-up.

refund.metadataDescription: Refund, return, replacement, and cancellation policy for One&Only.
refund.heroSubtitle: Terms for returns, replacements, cancellations, and refunds.
refund.overviewTitle: Clear guidance for damaged goods, cancellation windows, and refund eligibility.
refund.overviewDescription: This policy sets the expectations for product damage reporting, replacement handling, cancellation timing, and the conditions under which refunds are processed.

sections.title: General policy
items: Change requests are not accepted after delivery is completed, except for damaged or defective products.
Exchanges are only provided for products that arrive damaged or defective.
Product images on the website are representational and a few features may vary on the final product.
Cancellation is allowed before shipment. Discounted purchases are not eligible for cancellation.

sections.title: Damaged or defective products
items: Report damage within 24 hours of delivery by email with product photos.
Reverse pickup and replacement for damaged product cases are arranged by our team.
Replaceable faulty parts are usually arranged within 7 days; full replacement can take up to 15 days depending on availability.

sections.title: Returns and refunds
items: Returns are accepted only when products are damaged on arrival.
Refund is issued only if replacement or replacement parts are not available for the same product.
For non-damage refund requests, repackaging and transport charges may apply.
Refunds are processed via NEFT or back to the original payment method, usually within 7 working days.

sections.title: How to initiate return or cancellation
